scope: Six previously generic installed-base Cisco and Dell illustrations
method: Each drawing was made from a visually inspected official OEM front-panel photograph or service-manual diagram. Colored schematic shading and compressed perspective are editorial; drive arrangement and service-panel positions follow the cited reference. Hardware facts were not edited.

models.sourceTitle: Cisco UCS C245 M6 Installation and Service Guide — Overview
models.locator: External Features · Figure 1, Cisco UCS C245 M6 (SFF Drives, 24-Drive) Front Panel
features: Twenty-four vertical SFF carriers across the front
Power, identification and status indicators at the left
Vertical KVM connector and rack latch at the right
models.caveat: Reference-based illustration of the stated front configuration with the bezel removed. Depth, grille texture and tiny controls are simplified. Other supported drive cages and optional bezels look different; pictured bays are not a claim about maximum drive population or a complete bill of materials.
models.reviewMethod: Visually inspected official Figure 1 image in the browser; corroborated configuration against the C245 M6 SFF Spec Sheet p7.

limits: These are simplified exterior illustrations, not photographs or dimensioned engineering drawings.
Each card names the illustrated drive configuration; the same server may have other cages, bezels, rear drives and internal options.
The R7525 and R7615 share the same visible 24-SFF carrier layout in the cited figures; the illustration intentionally does not invent a cosmetic distinction between them.

validation.browserVisualReview: All six illustrated fronts visually inspected at normal desktop viewport; joined top/side/front geometry, no stray base elements, no clipping or card overflow.
validation.scope: Isolated illustration contact sheet; the parent task validates final integrated cards and responsive views.
